text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... huff!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Faster, faster! This isn't the limit! I'm
nowhere near
it yet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since the day she decided to run in the
Gekkei
Hai, Agnes Tachyon has been
setting new
personal records on a daily
basis.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon was already fast, but now she's
like crazy
fast!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
She's really pumped! The Gekkei Hai is
going to
be so exciting!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her legs, as if relieved of some hefty
burden,
bound across the track with
great vigor. She's
awakened to her
talent.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Phew!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it's written all over your face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although, I do find the sudden change a
bit
perplexing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If I have to answer, all I did was make a
choice.
The same thing you and
everybody else do. It's
nothing special.
choice_data_list: Still... what brought this on all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
All right, one more lap! Take my time,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In any case, it's clear Agnes Tachyon has

experienced a considerable change of
heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that she's showing motivation for
the Gekkei
Hai, I spend the night lying
awake, thinking about
how I can help.
choice_data_list: (Supporting her is my duty as her Trainer!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm her trainer. There has to be something I can do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I pull out the list of racers for the event
and begin
perusing all their past files...
By the time I look
out the window, dawn
has already broken.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... weather conditions, track
conditions,
track strategies, the list of
competitors, their
bloodline, their rivals,
favorable and unfavorable
tracks...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You did all this in one night? Hard to
imagine you
had any time to sleep.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh, did it please you that
much to see
my drive?
choice_data_list: I kind of got carried away...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, such thorough data will be of
great help
for the Gekkei Hai!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's an incredibly important race for me
to gather
quality data. We must be
completely prepared!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon closely studies the data I

compiled.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Is there something else? You look
awful
happy.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My, my! You're fired up today, aren't
you?
choice_data_list: Is there anything else I can do?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In that case... I can presume you won't
reject
being confined for ten days. It's
absolutely
imperative for my next
experiment. Heh-heh-heh.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My mouth begins to move before I can
finish
thinking things through... If it's to
see how far she
can go, I'll always agree.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I promise to try any concoction and
accept
whatever experiment comes my
way. Any plan she
comes up with, I'll
comply.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, hahaha! You—you've gone off
the deep
end now! The thing about
confinement was a
joke, of course! That's
against the law, you know?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well now... heh-heh-heh. I wonder
what's gotten
into you?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I attempt to describe what I felt
watching her that
day but end up at a
loss for words.
choice_data_list: (After seeing her like that, of course I'd...!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Faster, faster! This isn't the limit! I'm
nowhere near
it yet!
choice_data_list: (The way she looked on the track—)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The way she shot across the track, each

resonating step pushing her forward... I
couldn't
look away from her dazzling
display.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...What?
choice_data_list: I want to do whatever I can for them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that as long as we can go
beyond the
limits of Umamusume-kind
together, I'll do
anything for her. In
response, she falls curiously
silent.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that as long as we can go
beyond the
limits of Umamusume-kind
together, I'll do
anything for her. In
response, she falls curiously
silent.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah yes, of course! You haven't
changed... not
even a bit.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I also want to see what lies beyond your
limits.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I also want to see what lies beyond your
limits.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...That's what you said when you scouted
me. Do
you remember?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That day, in order to become my trainer,
you
downed an entire three bottles of
test solution.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Heh-heh, hahaha! I was taken aback
you know.
This guinea pig is the real
deal, I thought.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes have the look of someone
reminiscing
over a fond memory.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yes... That day, under the setting sun,
your eyes
were filled with madness.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...No, that's not quite right. Allow me to
correct
myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She looks me straight in the eye.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Even now, your eyes are filled with
madness.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It seems I'm the type with an affinity to
the
eccentric.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She lets out a small sigh.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, just when I thought I had
made my
decision. Could this be more
embarrassing?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
So long as the potential isn't zero, I can't
quit,
now can I?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
With that being the case, guinea pig, I'll
be
requiring your further cooperation
with my
experiments.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The fact that you're responsible for a
good half of
the troubles about to occur.
choice_data_list: Like I said, what are you talking about?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That day, she skips out on training after
three
weeks of perfect attendance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I have something to tell you.
Good news,
in fact.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I withdrew from the Gekkei Hai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With no further explanation, she retreats
to the
confines of her laboratory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Gekkei Hai quickly comes and goes
with her
absence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon's unexpected, one-sided
decision
is being talked about all over
the place.
